instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. In an indoor martial arts studio with wooden walls and dark floor mats, the man in the gray gi (R2) stands leaning over the man in the white gi (R1). The man in the white gi (R1) is bent deeply forward with his head tucked down. The man in the gray gi (R2) grips the upper collar of R1's white gi from behind, executing a grappling throw. Warm, natural indoor lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the floor.
elements: R2 leans over R1 during a grappling throw
R1 is bent deeply forward with his head tucked down
R2 grips the upper collar of R1's white gi from behind
R2 executes the throw while R1 is the person being thrown or controlled
R1's gi collar is the contact point used by R2
The scene is an indoor martial arts studio with wooden walls and dark floor mats
